Journals/ Conferences
1. Rakesh. Ranjan, A. Bhattacharya, H.B. Mishra and S. Mukhopadhyay, “A Gradient Ascent Based Low
Complexity Rate Maximization Algorithm for Intelligent Reﬂecting Surface-Aided OFDM Systems”
IEEE Communications Letters, vol. 27, no. 8, pp. 2083-2087, Aug. 2023, doi: 10.1109/LCOMM.2023.3289865.
2. Rakesh. Ranjan, A. Bhattacharya, H. B. Mishra and S. Mukhopadhyay, "A Low-Complexity Phase Shift
Optimization to Achieve Security in IRS-Assisted MISO Systems," IEEE National Conference on Com-
munications (NCC) 2024, IIT-Madras, Chennai, India, pp. 1-6, doi: 10.1109/NCC60321.2024.10485931.
3. Rakesh. Ranjan, A. Bhattacharya, H.B. Mishra and S. Mukhopadhyay, “Achievable Rate Maximization
for Reconﬁgurable Intelligent Surface-Assisted MIMO Systems: A Novel Low-Complexity Solution,”
Elsevier Signal Processing (under revision).
4. Rakesh. Ranjan, A. Bhattacharya, M.V. Katwe, H.B. Mishra, K.Singh and D. W. Kwan Ng, “ A Robust
STAR-RIS-aided MU-MIMO System for Integrated Sensing and Communication,” IEEE Transactions
on Wireless Communications (under revision).
